component.name: Nebula Note
component.summary: Notes, docs and databases in deep space

description.p: Nebula Note is a fast, local workspace for notes, documents and databases, in the spirit of Notion. Everything lives in one file on your computer: no account, no server.

ul.li: A block editor with headings, lists, to-dos, toggles, callouts, code, equations, tables, columns and synced blocks
Databases with table, board, list, calendar, timeline, gallery and chart views, formulas, relations and rollups
Full-text search, version history, comments, reminders and backlinks
Import from Notion, Markdown, HTML, Word, Evernote and CSV; export to Markdown, HTML and PDF
Daily backups with an integrity check, to any folder you choose

description.p: Much faster with long pages and big databases, a new storage format with full-text search and compressed history, background backups with integrity checks, safer links, and screen reader and keyboard support.
